cast.name: 萨拉赫·本萨拉 Salah Bensalah

director.name: 希沙姆·拉赛瑞 Hicham Lasri

introduction: On the eve of her 30th birthday, Cathy discovers to her amazement that life has not been kind to her, especially her parents, her fiancé, her boss, and society. At this moment, the worst day of her life begins; in other words, a terrible day in a sardonic Casablanca will redefine her destiny. Cathy decides to start over and seeks to immigrate, but things don’t go as planned.源自：https://mad-distribution.film/movies/movie1115369.php
